finding: The root specs path is a tracked mode-120000 symlink to .opencode/specs, so materializing a real directory changes Git topology.
The source repository negates global /specs and /.opencode/ ignores, while the configured global file still ignores those paths by default.
Downstream repositories without the local negations will continue to ignore a real top-level specs directory under the anchored global /specs rule.
Provider-specific ignore entries encode .opencode/specs and do not automatically follow a move to specs/.
Git child-path ignore inspection through the current specs symlink fails beyond the symlink; the future real-directory topology needs separate validation.
